groups.name: argi.graph.observation
groups.description: Configuration properties for Graph observation functionality.

properties.name: argi.graph.observation.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable graph observation functionality.

properties.name: argi.graph.observation.capture-content
properties.description: Whether to attach raw prompt, completion, and graph state content to high-cardinality observation attributes.

properties.name: argi.graph.observation.max-content-length
